rules.description: Applicant must be at least 16 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be 16 or over to claim PIP

rules.description: Applicant must be under State Pension age for new claims
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot usually make a new PIP claim if you're over State Pension age. You can apply for Attendance Allowance instead.

rules.description: Applicant must have a long-term health condition or disability
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have a long-term physical or mental health condition or disability to claim PIP

rules.description: Difficulties must be expected to last at least 12 months
rules.reason_if_failed: Your difficulties must be expected to last for at least 12 months from when they started

rules.description: Applicant must have difficulty with daily living tasks or getting around
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have difficulty doing certain everyday tasks or getting around because of your condition

rules.description: Applicant must be living in England or Wales when applying
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be living in England or Wales to apply for PIP. If you live in Scotland, apply for Adult Disability Payment instead.

rules.description: Applicant usually needs to have lived in UK for 2 of last 3 years
rules.reason_if_failed: You usually need to have lived in England, Scotland or Wales for at least 2 of the last 3 years

rules.description: Applicant must not be subject to immigration control
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot claim PIP if you are subject to immigration control, unless you're a sponsored immigrant or have refugee/humanitarian protection status

rules.description: Cannot get Armed Forces Independence Payment at same time
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot get PIP and Armed Forces Independence Payment at the same time

explanation_template: PIP eligibility: {outcome}. You may be eligible for daily living component ({daily_living_rate}), mobility component ({mobility_rate}), or both.

edge_cases.description: Applicant might have 12 months or less to live
edge_cases.action: Fast-track claim under special rules for end of life. Automatic higher daily living rate. No face-to-face assessment needed. Requires SR1 form from medical professional.

edge_cases.description: Over State Pension age but received PIP or ADP in last 12 months
edge_cases.action: Can make new PIP claim as exception to age rule
Tell DWP you have moved. Make new claim for Adult Disability Payment. PIP stops 13 weeks after move.
Tell Social Security Scotland you have moved. Make new PIP claim. ADP stops 13 weeks after move.

edge_cases.description: Recently returned from EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein
edge_cases.action: May be able to get PIP sooner than standard 2-of-3-years residency requirement

edge_cases.description: Lives in EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein
edge_cases.action: Can only get help with daily living tasks, not mobility component

edge_cases.description: Works in Armed Forces or is family member of someone who does
edge_cases.action: May still be able to claim PIP while living abroad. Special rules apply.
DWP will invite you to apply for PIP. Do not apply until DWP writes to you unless your circumstances change.
You can claim PIP but will get less of the daily living part

edge_cases.description: Currently receiving War Pensioners' Mobility Supplement
edge_cases.action: You can claim PIP but will not get the mobility part
